acceptance_criteria.name: B1_engagement_composition_with_carried_profile_held_PRIMARY
acceptance_criteria.rule: PRIMARY criterion for this experiment -- the graded pre-acting candidate's first-switch (B1) onset engagement profile is this cycle's selected limitation (criterion 9 FAILed on BOTH of its cohorts on sub-condition (a) alone, on complementary halves: development's count met at 3/6 with zero non-full firings, additional's non-full credit met with two retained partials but its count 2/6, with harm passing both comparisons on both cohorts). This criterion is the conjunction of four carried forms, graded per cohort, and PASSes only if ALL FOUR sides hold on the same cohort: (a) B1 SIDE, criterion 9's frozen form in full (abstention TAKEN in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B1 onset states, at least 1 of the taken states a NON-FULL firing -- a retained partial, the only non-full class, now reachable through leg R OR leg C -- B1 harm <= guard AND < recent8); AND (b) STATIONARY SIDE, criterion 6's frozen form in full (abstentions <= 32/240, successes >= recent8 - 6, harm <= recent8 on the stationary control arm); AND (c) B2 SIDE, criterion 1's frozen form in full, with the inverted minority model carried as the candidate's minority model (minority TAKEN >= 3/6 pooled B2 onset, selectivity <= 1/6 at B1 and <= 1/6 at return-A, B2 harm <= guard AND <= 0.60 x recent8, successes >= guard + 16); AND (d) RELEASE SIDE, criterion 5's frozen form in full (abstentions <= 36/144, successes >= recent8 - 8, non-recent8 branch in at most 1 of the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 states, abstained branch in 0 of those 9 states). Criteria 9, 6, 1, 5, 11, and 4 are ALSO graded individually below in their carried forms, so a failure of this conjunction is attributable to its exact side and sub-condition, never hidden inside the PRIMARY verdict. Every graded population is ALSO reported for the decisive baseline method (pre_acting_joint_release_recovery) on the same cohort, and every B1 onset state is reported with its trigger kind, preceding_pair_opposed_count, companion fields (matched / concordant / armed), both methods' taken branches, and both methods' successes / harm -- those states at which the two methods differ are, by construction, exactly the states where a partial trigger was disarmed by leg R under the baseline but taken through leg C by the candidate, so the report states exactly what the companion leg changed on these cohorts: how many B1 firings it added per cohort (split by checkpoint), how many stationary and checkpoint-32 firings it added, and what each was worth. The grading cap in the grading record (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one B1 onset state in at least one cohort at which the decisive baseline took no abstention and the candidate took a retained-partial abstention through leg C) applies on top of this criterion, so a conjunction PASS with zero exercised companion firings on both cohorts is reported as a carried-profile pass with a companion null result, never as an engagement-composition demonstration.

acceptance_criteria.name: first_switch_B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried from the pre-acting protocol (the B1 side of criterion 11, in the widened-removal protocol's non-full form); it is PRIMARY criterion 15's B1 side and this experiment's selected limitation in its exact frozen form, graded individually. Leg C's exposure is this criterion entire: a B1 partial state whose preceding pair is silent (leg R failing) is taken iff its companion event is not reference-concordant (leg C armed), leg P and the carried authority holding and neither recovery branch firing; taken states are reported split by corroboration path (leg R only / leg C only / both) and by checkpoint, so the composition credit is attributable to its exact path. Co-graded guard, carried from the widened-window protocol (the B1 side of criterion 11) in the widened-removal protocol's form (non-full credit a retained partial only); it is PRIMARY criterion 15's B1 side, graded individually. The abstention branch is unchanged in this experiment, so leg T's only exposure here is fall-through from a stood-down recovery branch at a B1 state (in the rate model neither recovery branch fires at B1 onset; a B1 checkpoint-32 regular routing is a criterion 5 population, not a criterion 9 one). Co-graded guard, carried from the widened-window protocol (the B1 side of criterion 11) with ONE form change that the single changed element forces, stated explicitly: the non-full credit is a RETAINED PARTIAL only, because the widened class is removed -- this is the non-full form criterion 9 carried in the preceding-pair protocol, before the widened class existed. It is PRIMARY criterion 15's B1 side, graded individually. Co-graded guard, criterion 9's B1 form carried from the preceding-pair protocol, its non-full credit a retained partial (the widened-window protocol updated the credit to retained partial OR widened; this experiment's removal of the widened class returns the credit to the preceding-pair form, stated here so the change of form is never mistaken for a carried invariant) - the B1 side of PRIMARY criterion 11, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The graded preceding-pair candidate's B1 profile (TAKEN 1/6 on both cohorts, sole full firing each, B1 harm 78 = guard 78 and < recent8 92 / 94, B1 successes 2 vs recent8 4 / 2) is what this cycle must repair without giving back the harm profile. Graded per cohort over the B1 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): (a) ENGAGEMENT - the abstention branch is TAKEN (a trigger class holds, carried-over abstention authority armed, abstention gate armed for the trigger kind (leg P; plus, when the trigger is partial, leg R (preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1) OR leg C (the companion event not reference-concordant); there is no widened trigger in this candidate), acting source abstained) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B1 onset seed-checkpoint states, AND at least 1 of the taken states is a NON-FULL firing (abstention_trigger_kind == 'partial' - a retained partial-only firing; the widened kind does not exist in this candidate, its removal being the single changed element, so no widened firing can supply this credit as it could in the widened-window and inverted-archive protocols taken); AND (b) HARM vs GUARD - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort; AND (c) HARM vs RECENT8 - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells < recent8 harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort (strictly below: equality FAILs, as in the preceding protocols). Taken states are reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled) AND by trigger kind (full / partial / widened), with the realized reference_purity, purity_armed flag, opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, and acting_opposed_count at each, and against the records-only preceding-pair-rule (the decisive derivation), widened-rule (this candidate's own rule, for cross-checking), partial-purity-rule, purity-only-rule, partial-ungated-rule, reference-purity-rule, abstention-release-rule, and abstention-higher-corroboration-rule derivations at the same states (see metrics_reported), so the report states exactly how many B1 firings the widened class added on THIS cohort, split by checkpoint, how many leg P, leg R, or authority blocked, and what each added or removed firing was worth in harm. B1 successes are reported in full alongside (not graded here, to keep the harm claim honest rather than productivity-free: always_abstain would pass (b) and (c) trivially, so the report must state candidate B1 pooled successes against recent8's and the guard's explicitly). Recovery and minority firing at B1 are reported alongside, as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: stationary_control_selectivity_not_given_back
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the pre-acting protocol (the stationary side of criterion 11); here it is PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary side, graded individually. Leg C's stationary price is this criterion's direct exposure: a control-arm partial state with preceding_pair_opposed_count 0 and an unmatched companion now abstains (published-rate expectation +0.039 adjusted per state, ~+0.6 firings / ~+9 episodes per cohort; 0 under the raw pair); every candidate-vs-decisive-baseline control difference is named per state with its companion fields. Leg T remains carried and inert on this arm in the rate model, as in the pre-acting protocol. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol (the stationary side of criterion 11) through the inverted-archive and widened-removal protocols; here it is PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary side, graded individually. Leg T is inert on the stationary arm in the published-rate model (the joint rate is 0 where archive and reference majorities coincide); any realized control-arm difference between candidate and decisive baseline is named per state with its stale counts. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol (the stationary side of criterion 11) through the inverted-archive protocol, where it FAILed on both cohorts; Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the preceding protocols - the stationary side of PRIMARY criterion 11, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. In the preceding generation this criterion PASSed on development at exact recent8 parity (0/240 abstentions, 110 = 110 successes, 130 = 130 harm - a leg-retention pass: the partial-purity-rule took 2 control states and leg R disarmed both) and FAILed on additional by 1 success on ONE carried FULL firing (seed 443017 k=2, purity 0.889), leg R having disarmed all three partial stationary states there. This cycle prices the carried classes' stationary volume ALONE: the widened exposure priced in the widened-window and inverted-archive protocols (a stationary state whose newest four are silent or split but whose acting window accumulates >= 3 opposed events, joint 0.056 raw / 0.034 adjusted per state) is REMOVED by construction -- a widened-armed stationary state is records-only in this candidate and the candidate must NOT abstain there; any candidate abstention at a state whose only trigger would have been the widened class is an implementation defect charged under criterion 7 as well. What remains priced is exactly what preceded the widened class: full firings untouched by any leg, and retained partials at the preceding-pair rate (union stationary trigger expectation 0.108 raw / 0.072 adjusted per state, ~1.6 / ~1.1 firings per cohort). Graded per cohort, on the stationary control arm pooled across checkpoints 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 (240 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 32 of 240, AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 6, AND (c) candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions. The realized reference_purity, opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and abstention_trigger_kind on the control arm are recorded and reported at every checkpoint, alongside the realized minority_fraction and minority_armed values exactly as in the preceding protocols; every control checkpoint at which the candidate's taken branch differs from the records-only preceding-pair-rule derivation (in particular every WIDENED state, which the graded preceding-pair candidate would not have taken) and from the records-only partial-purity-rule and purity-only-rule derivations, and every abstention that was taken, is stated explicitly in the report, with the taken or disarmed state's purity, opposed counts, and trigger kind named. If no stationary widened trigger survived on a cohort, the PASS is reported with the widened-armed and widened-disarmed counts stated - not as a no-trigger PASS, since the widened-rule derivation states how many widened triggers existed.

acceptance_criteria.name: second_switch_B2_protection_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, criterion 1's form carried from the preceding protocols and promoted into PRIMARY criterion 15's B2 side, graded individually. Leg C's exposure here is fall-through only: at a B2 onset state where neither recovery branch fired, a companion-armed partial trigger now abstains where the decisive baseline acted on recent8, charged here exactly as an abstention firing was charged in the preceding protocols (abstention is not the B2 protective branch; the exposed population is the non-engaged residue); such states are named per cohort with their corroboration path. Leg T's carried B2 exposure (minority stand-downs) is unchanged from the pre-acting protocol. Co-graded guard, criterion 1's form carried from the preceding protocols and promoted into PRIMARY criterion 15's B2 side, graded individually. Leg T's exposure here is the minority branch's onset stand-down: a B2 onset state whose stale minority pair count is >= 2 (published-rate expectation 2.2 percent raw / 1.0 percent adjusted of firings) falls through to abstention or recent8 and is charged here exactly as a minority non-firing is charged in the carried form; the stale-disarmed states are named per cohort. Co-graded guard, criterion 1's form carried from the preceding protocols and promoted into PRIMARY criterion 15's B2 side - graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The SINGLE changed element's exposure is exactly this criterion: branch selection (arming, joint test, purity gate, recovery precedence) is identical to the decisive baseline by construction, so sub-conditions (a) and (b) are the decisive baseline method's figures on the same cohort, while the harm and successes in (c) and (d) at minority-fired states are scored through the INVERTED minority model (see minority_model), carried unchanged. The removal's own exposure on this criterion is the fall-through at B2 states where neither recovery branch fired and the widened class would have abstained: there the candidate acts on recent8 where the decisive baseline abstained, charged here exactly as abstention firing was charged in the preceding protocols. Co-graded guard, carried over unchanged in form from the minority, reference-purity, abstention-release, and abstention-higher-corroboration protocols: the carried abstention classes (full and retained partial -- the widened class is REMOVED in this experiment) and the carried inverted minority model must together hold the B2 protection the minority branch demonstrated (abstention is not the B2 protective branch - minority recovery is, and it sits above abstention in the decision order - but abstention firing, or its removal, at B2 states where neither recovery branch fired changes those states' harm, in either direction, and that is charged here, exactly as in the widened-window protocol). Graded per cohort over the B2 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): (a) ENGAGEMENT - the minority recovery branch is TAKEN (minority_joint_count >= 1, minority branch armed, purity gate armed, acting source minority_archive) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B2 onset seed-checkpoint states; AND (b) SELECTIVITY - the minority recovery branch is taken in at most 1 of the 6 pooled B1 onset states AND at most 1 of the 6 pooled return-A onset states on the same cohort; AND (c) HARM - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B2 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort, AND candidate B2 pooled onset harm <= 0.60 * recent8 B2 pooled onset harm on the same cohort; AND (d) PRODUCTIVITY - candidate successes pooled over the B2 onset cells >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16. Taken states are reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled), with the realized minority_fraction, minority_armed flag, reference_purity, and purity_armed flag at each, and against the records-only minority-rule and reference-purity-rule derivations (see metrics_reported). Abstention-branch firing (split by trigger kind, now including widened) and abstention-gate disarmings (by cause: leg P vs leg R vs both) at B2 are reported (with realized opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, and acting_opposed_count at each) but do NOT count toward sub-condition (a), as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: release_and_productivity_by_checkpoint_32
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the pre-acting protocol, graded individually; it is PRIMARY criterion 15's release side. Leg C's exposure here is the late partial firing: a switch-stage checkpoint-32 state whose partial trigger is disarmed by leg R under the decisive baseline but whose companion is unmatched abstains in this candidate (published-rate pattern 0.029-0.039 per state adjusted, 0 raw, before leg P, the authority, and recovery precedence), charging sub-conditions (a) and (d) directly; every one of the 9 states per cohort is reported with branch, trigger kind, preceding count, companion fields, stale counts, purity, and both methods' successes / harm. Leg T and the recovery branches are carried unchanged, so the carried routing populations (sub-conditions (b) and (c)) are the decisive baseline's except where a leg-C abstention pre-empts a branch the baseline took, which is reported as such. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-removal protocol, graded individually; it is PRIMARY criterion 15's release side and this experiment's selected limitation in its exact frozen form. Leg T's exposure is this criterion entire: a checkpoint-32 state counts as non-recent8 only if the branch that would route there also has a stale-pair count < 2 for its own joint definition; every one of the 9 states per cohort is reported with branch, stale_joint_pair_count, stale_minority_joint_pair_count, purity, and both methods' successes / harm, so sub-condition (c)'s population is recomputable from the records alone. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol, graded individually; it is also PRIMARY criterion 15's release side. The inverted minority model's exposure here is direct and carried: any checkpoint-32 minority routing is scored through the inverted model (the inverted cycle's additional-cohort failure and Regression were exactly two such routings), and sub-conditions (b) and (c) charge it exactly as the carried form charged minority routings. The removal's exposure here inverts the widened protocols': a checkpoint-32 state the decisive baseline abstains from through the widened class is ACTED on by the candidate, and its outcome is charged under (b) and (c) in the opposite direction. Co-graded guard - the graded partial candidate PASSed it on the additional cohort and FAILed it on development on the records sub-condition (c) alone (2 of 9 non-recent8 states, both carried minority routings, abstained branch 0 of 9 on both cohorts, the development zero via an exercised leg-P release at purity 0.658 and the additional zero via two leg-P-disarmed return-A partial triggers); all four sub-conditions are carried unchanged in form, and neither the preceding-pair leg nor the widened class's removal may give any of them back - sub-condition (d) is the exposed one on the abstention side: for partial triggers, at checkpoint 32 the preceding pair shares the newest pair's segment, so a late partial trigger's leg-R retention is segment-dependent; the widened class no longer exists, so no late widened abstention can occur -- but a state the decisive baseline abstains from at checkpoint 32 through the widened class is acted on here, and sub-conditions (b) and (c) charge its outcomed, since neither had a widened class. Graded per cohort, pooled across stages B1, return_A, and B2 at checkpoint 32 (144 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 36 of 144 (25 percent), AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 8 (carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (c) from the candidate's decision records alone, among the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 seed-checkpoint states (3 stages x 3 seeds), the candidate takes a non-recent8 branch (retained_archive, minority_archive, or abstained) in at most 1 state - the carried records-level release measure for the recovery branches - AND (d) the candidate takes the ABSTAINED branch in 0 of those 9 states (carried from the preceding protocols: both combined-gate generations and the partial generation removed abstention from the late records on both cohorts; the preceding-pair leg must hold that at zero for partial triggers, not merely at the carried allowance). The realized reference_purity, purity_armed, opposing counts (newest opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and supporting_opposed_count) and abstention_trigger_kind at all 9 states are reported alongside, split by branch taken, so the report distinguishes a leg-P release of a late abstention (trigger present, purity disarmed, fell through to recent8), a leg-R release of a late PARTIAL abstention (trigger partial, purity armed, preceding_pair_opposed_count == 0, fell through to recent8), a late WIDENED trigger released by leg P (kind widened, purity disarmed) or never armed (widened_armed false), and a state where no abstention trigger of any class was present at all, and likewise distinguishes the recovery branches' purity releases as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_with_stationary_selectivity_PRIMARY
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried from the widened-window protocol through the inverted-archive, widened-removal, and pre-acting protocols; here its two sides are PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary and B1 sides, graded individually. Leg C's exposure on this criterion is its two priced populations exactly: added companion-armed partial firings at B1 onset (its benefit) and on the control arm (its price), each reported split by checkpoint and corroboration path. Co-graded guard, carried from the widened-window protocol through the inverted-archive and widened-removal protocols; here its two sides are PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary and B1 sides, graded individually. Leg T's exposure on this criterion's populations is fall-through only (the leg is inert on the control arm and at B1 onset in the published-rate model; any realized difference is charged here). Co-graded guard, carried from the widened-window protocol (where it was the PRIMARY criterion and PASSed on both cohorts) through the inverted-archive protocol (where it was PRIMARY criterion 12's carried-profile side and FAILed on both cohorts); here its two sides are PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary and B1 sides, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The candidate carries leg R, leg P, and both recovery branches' selection rules unchanged from the graded inverted-archive candidate; the SINGLE changed element -- the widened class's removal -- is this criterion's direct subject: its stationary side prices the carried classes alone, and its B1 side's non-full credit is a retained partial only (see criterion 9's updated form). The inverted minority model's only exposure on this criterion's populations is a minority firing at a B1 or control state, charged here if it occurs.PRIMARY criterion 15's stationary and B1 sides are this criterion's two sides in their forms AS UPDATED in this protocol (criterion 6's stationary form unchanged; criterion 9's B1 form with the non-full credit a retained partial only, the widened class being removed): graded per cohort, PASSes only if BOTH sides hold on the same cohort -- (a) STATIONARY SIDE, criterion 6's frozen form in full, and (b) B1 SIDE, criterion 9's frozen form in full as updated. The widened-window protocol's own criterion-11 text, which this criterion carried verbatim through the inverted-archive protocol, is superseded here in exactly the non-full credit and the widened-reporting clauses, because the widened class no longer exists in the candidate; its population is reported records-only (widened-armed states, the decisive baseline method's widened-taken states, and the candidate's branches at those states, split by checkpoint), so the removal's exercised states remain as visible in the report as the widened class's firings were in its own cycle. Taken and disarmed states are reported against the records-only preceding-pair-rule (this candidate's own abstention rule), widened-rule (the decisive baseline's abstention rule, records-only), partial-purity-rule, and purity-only-rule derivations at the same states, so the report states exactly how many stationary and B1 firings the removed class would have added on THIS cohort, split by checkpoint, and what each side was worth in successes and harm.

acceptance_criteria.name: return_A_onset_harm_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the pre-acting protocol, graded individually. Leg C's exposure here mirrors its B1 exposure: return-A onset is a switch onset (the newest events are opposite-rule against a B1-dominated reference), so a companion-armed partial at a return-A onset state where neither recovery branch fired now abstains where the decisive baseline acted on recent8, charged here in either direction exactly as an abstention firing was charged in the preceding protocols; such states are named per cohort. Leg T's carried return-A exposure is unchanged from the pre-acting protocol. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-removal protocol, graded individually. Leg T's exposure here is the return-A onset stand-down: a return-A onset state whose regular branch would fire but whose stale_joint_pair_count is >= 2 (published-rate expectation 2.2 percent raw / 1.0 percent adjusted of firings) falls through to the minority branch, abstention, or recent8, and its harm is charged here in either direction exactly as a recovery firing was charged in the preceding protocols; stale-disarmed return-A states are named per cohort. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the inverted-archive protocol, graded individually. The removal's exposure here is the return-A fall-through: a return-A onset state where neither recovery branch fired and the widened class would have abstained is acted on through recent8 by the candidate, charged in either direction exactly as a widened firing was charged in the preceding protocols. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol, graded individually. Co-graded guard, carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols: per cohort, pooled across return_A checkpoints 2 and 4 (96 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate harmful TEST actions <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions over the same cells, AND (b) candidate harmful TEST actions <= 0.60 * recent8 harmful TEST actions over the same cells. The graded partial candidate PASSed it on development (36 vs guard 75, ceiling 52.2) and FAILed it on additional (53 vs guard 53 - sub-condition (a) PASS at equality - but ceiling 51.0 FAIL by 2; candidate identical to every carried gate-generation baseline method at return-A onset on additional, regular recovery TAKEN 4 of 6 there and 6 of 6 on development: inherited from the carried profile, not produced by the widened trigger, charged unchanged in that grading); it is carried unchanged as a co-graded guard: at return-A onset the abstention branch is mostly disarmed by stable disagreement already, so the preceding-pair leg's exposure here is small by construction and the widened class no longer exists (its removal can change a return-A state only by the fall-through described above), and any change - or any repeat of the inherited failure - is charged as recorded, with widened-armed return-A states and their candidate branches reported.

acceptance_criteria.name: return_A_recovery_successes_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Carried in the identical frozen form from the pre-acting protocol, graded individually; the pre-acting candidate's return-A successes on the same cohort are reported alongside in full, as the decisive baseline. Leg C enters this criterion only through fall-through (an added return-A abstention contributes 0 successes at its state), reported per state. Carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-removal protocol, graded individually; the widened-removal candidate's return-A successes on the same cohort are reported alongside in full, as the decisive baseline. Per cohort, pooled across return_A checkpoints 2 and 4 (96 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate successes >= 40 percent of frozen_A successes pooled over the same cells (computed as candidate_successes * 5 >= frozen_A_successes * 2, carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (b) candidate successes >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16 (carried over unchanged). Cumulative's, the joint candidate's, the bounded candidate's, the long candidate's, the extended candidate's, the minority candidate's, the reference-purity candidate's, the abstention-release candidate's, the abstention-higher-corroboration candidate's, and the partial-opposition and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are reported alongside in full, and any shortfall is stated in the report, not hidden. The abstention branch (at any trigger threshold or gate composition) sits below both recovery branches and does not enter this criterion's mechanism; the abstention-purity-only, partial-opposition, and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are also reported alongside in full; it is carried so that any unexpected interaction (for example a fall-through change at a return-A onset state) is graded, not assumed away.

acceptance_criteria.name: pooled_onset_harm_not_above_guard
acceptance_criteria.rule: Carried in the identical frozen form from the pre-acting protocol, graded individually. Leg C's onset exposure here is one-directional and stated honestly: every state leg C newly abstains contributes 0 harm to the pooled figure where the decisive baseline's recent8 action contributed its realized harm, so leg C can only lower this criterion's pooled figure at its exercised states; its cost is charged to the successes-side criteria (9's full report, 6, 2, and 5(b)), never hidden inside this harm PASS. Leg T's carried onset fall-throughs are charged as in the pre-acting protocol. Carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-removal protocol, graded individually. Leg T's onset fall-throughs (a stood-down recovery state acted on through recent8 or a lower branch) are charged in the pooled figure and in the per-cell comparisons exactly as recovery firings were charged in the preceding protocols. Carried in the identical frozen form from the inverted-archive protocol, graded individually. Carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol, graded individually. Per cohort, pooled across the six onset cells (stages B1, return_A, B2 x checkpoints 2 and 4; 288 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate harmful TEST actions <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same six cells on the same cohort, AND (b) candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions in at least 5 of the 6 individual cells. Carried over unchanged from the graded joint, bounded, long, extended, minority, reference-purity, abstention-release, abstention-higher-corroboration, abstention-purity-only, and partial-opposition protocols. The graded partial candidate PASSed it on both cohorts (75 vs guard 198, 6 of 6 cells, development; 102 vs guard 171, 6 of 6, additional - the pooled figure the higher-corroboration generation failed on additional, restored by the B1 repair); this cycle grades whether the carried legs WITHOUT the widened class keep the pooled figure under the guard on NEW cohorts -- in particular whether the removal's fall-throughs at B1, B2, or return-A (states acted on through recent8 where the decisive baseline abstained, adding whatever harm recent8 realizes there) or the carried checkpoint-2 partial disarmings return any cell's harm past recent8 or the pooled figure past the guard. Checkpoint 0 is reported but NOT graded.

acceptance_criteria.name: full_accounting

budgets.abstention_budget: Criteria 15(b) / 11 / 6 bound abstention's downstream cost on the stationary control arm (at most 32 of 240) and criterion 5 bounds it at checkpoint 32 (at most 36 of 144, plus 0 abstained states among the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 states under criterion 5(d)); criteria 15(a) / 11 / 9 set a FLOOR, not a budget, on B1 onset protective abstention (>= 3 of 6 states taken, at least 1 of them a retained-partial firing). The abstention branch is changed in this experiment ONLY by leg C for partial triggers (full and retained-partial classes only, the widened class's removal carried): the published-rate stationary expectation is ~25.8 raw / ~26.7 adjusted episodes per cohort (the decisive baseline's ~25.8 / ~17.3 plus leg C's +0 raw / ~+9 adjusted), inside the 32 budget in expectation under both rate pairs. Leg T (carried) adds no abstention and removes none directly; its fall-through exposure is charged as in the pre-acting protocol. A candidate abstention recorded with kind widened remains an implementation defect under criterion 7, and a leg-C firing records kind partial, never a new kind.
budgets.harm_budget: Criterion 15(a) / 9: candidate B1 pooled onset harm at most the evidence_opposition_guard baseline's B1 pooled onset harm on the SAME cohort and strictly below recent8's, as carried. Criterion 15(c) / 1(c): candidate B2 pooled onset harm at most the guard's and at most 60 percent of recent8's on the same cohort, as carried. Criterion 3: candidate pooled onset (all stages, checkpoints 2 and 4) harm at most the guard's, with at least 5 of 6 individual onset cells at or below recent8. Criterion 4: candidate pooled return-A onset harm at most the guard's and at most 60 percent of recent8's. Criterion 15(d) / 5(b): candidate checkpoint-32 successes at least recent8 - 8 per cohort. Leg C's harm effect is NOT hidden by these budgets: an abstained state contributes exactly 0 successes and 0 harmful actions, so at every state where the decisive baseline acted (on recent8 or a fall-through branch) and the candidate abstained through leg C, both methods' successes and harm at that state are reported per state in the grading report, in each direction, including any productive state the abstention gave back.
budgets.train_actor_harm: No cap is claimed: the external actor's harm is a fixed cost of the shared evidence stream, identical for all methods, and is published in full per seed (criterion 7). It is never hidden inside or netted against TEST results.

expected_failure_modes: Leg-C null / raw-like draws (pre-registered, the cycle's central risk): leg C arms only when a partial pair's companion event is unmatched, a population the raw all-matched rate pair prices at zero. If these cohorts' draws are raw-like in their matched structure, leg C never arms, the candidate coincides with the decisive baseline at every state, criterion 9's outcome is whatever the carried classes produce, and the leg demonstrated nothing. The grading cap (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one B1 onset state in at least one cohort at which the decisive baseline's partial was disarmed by leg R and the candidate took that partial through leg C) applies; the adjusted-rate expectation is ~0.70 exercised B1 states per cohort trigger-level (P(at least one) ~0.52 per cohort), so an unexercised leg on both cohorts is a live possibility, stated in advance. Companion fields are reported at every B1 state, not buried.

Engagement draw still short (bounded, recorded): the added expectation is +0.116 adjusted pooled partial states per state (~+0.70 of 6 B1 states per cohort trigger-level, before leg P, the authority, and recovery precedence), but criterion 9(a) is a small-integer conjunction -- the count can still fail if the full side draws low (full rate 0.449 adjusted per state is the baseline's own variance), and the composition can still fail if every taken partial arrives through leg R at checkpoint 4 while the count is met on fulls alone in the other configuration, or if the taken set is again kind-skewed by the trigger draws themselves. The decisive baseline method's taken counts and kinds on the same cohort are reported alongside so leg C's own share of any shortfall (at most the companion-armed states) is exact.

Stationary price realized high (pre-registered): leg C adds ~+0.6 expected partial firings per cohort on the control arm under the adjusted pair (0 raw), each a full 16-episode abstention. Criterion 6(a)'s volume budget absorbs the expectation (~26.7 of 240 adjusted), but criterion 6(b)'s -6 success margin does not price volume, it prices placement: one added firing at a control state where recent8 scores >= 7 consumes the whole margin unless offset by productive control recovery, exactly the mechanism by which two carried partial firings at k=16 broke additional's criterion 6 in the pre-acting cycle. Charged under criteria 15 / 11 / 6 with the added states named (companion-armed, preceding 0) per cohort.

Checkpoint-32 late firing (pre-registered): the leg-C-only pattern at a switch-stage checkpoint-32 state (partial trigger, leg R failing, companion unmatched) is priced at 0.029-0.039 per state adjusted (0 raw) before leg P, the authority, and recovery precedence -- ~0.26-0.35 states per cohort trigger-level. One realized late firing takes the abstained branch at checkpoint 32 and fails criterion 5(d) (0 of 9) outright, and its 16 episodes charge criterion 5(a). Leg C does not address criterion 5's carried failure modes at all (the pre-acting cycle failed it on different sub-conditions per cohort, both through recovery routings leg C never touches); criterion 5 is a guard here, and a carried-profile failure of it is charged, not excused.

Switch-onset fall-through at B2 and return-A (stated in advance): leg C applies at every partial-trigger state, not only B1. At B2 and return-A onset states where neither recovery branch fired, a companion-armed partial now abstains where the decisive baseline acted on recent8, charged under criteria 1, 4, and 3 in either direction (an abstention contributes 0 successes and 0 harm at that state; at B2 the protective branch is minority recovery, which sits above abstention, so the exposed population is the non-engaged residue -- the same residue whose harm failed criterion 1's ceiling on additional in the pre-acting cycle). Every such state is reported with its corroboration path (leg R / leg C / both) so the attribution is exact.

Unmatched-population heterogeneity (stated in advance): the unmatched category pools two unlike cases -- events whose reported outcome is neutral (the external actor chose a neutral-effect action) and events whose span has no non-neutral reference majority in the reference window (a reference-sampling property). The published-rate model treats their pooled share (0.20 adjusted) as rule-independent, which holds for each case separately, but the realized MIX can differ across cohorts and checkpoints; if a cohort's unmatched population is dominated by majority-less spans concentrated in particular segments, leg C's realized discrimination is weaker than the model's pooled figure. The companion records (matched flag per event, span, reference majority) make the mix visible per state in the report.

Leg-P and authority interaction (carried, stated): an added partial still requires leg P armed and the carried abstention authority armed, and sits below both recovery branches. Purity disarmings at B1 in the pre-acting cycle were zero (purity armed at all 12 B1 onset states on both cohorts), but a purity- or authority-blocked companion-armed state on these cohorts is a carried-profile outcome, charged identically to candidate and decisive baseline and reported as such, never attributed to leg C.

Inversion-structure limit (carried over, stated): the carried minority branch and its inverted model exploit this simulator's exact-inversion structure (B is the precise progress / damage inversion of A). Any PASS remains bounded to this inversion simulator -- evidence about a companion-concordance corroboration condition on the retained-partial abstention class for a two-switch onset family, in this simulator only, not a general engagement mechanism, not calibrated uncertainty, and not real-world safety.

fixed_parameters.decision_rule: Evaluated in this exact order on every decision once the signals are evaluable: (1) RECOVERY - if joint_count >= 1 AND the recovery branch is armed (carried-over authority) AND the purity gate is armed, act through the recovery model (source recorded as retained_archive), exactly as the graded candidates. (2) MINORITY RECOVERY - else if minority_joint_count >= 1 AND the minority branch is armed (minority_fraction >= 0.25 AND minority_discordant_count >= 8) AND the purity gate is armed, act through the INVERTED minority model defined in minority_model / inverted_archive_model (source recorded as minority_archive), carried unchanged from the graded inverted-archive candidate. (3) ABSTENTION - else if a trigger class holds (FULL: opposed_count == 2; PARTIAL: opposed_count == 1 -- the widened class of the graded widened-window and inverted-archive candidates, newest4_opposed_count <= 1 AND acting_opposed_count >= 3, is REMOVED, the single changed element of this experiment; its quantities remain recorded records-only) AND the abstention branch is armed (carried-over authority) AND the abstention gate is armed for this trigger kind (leg P: reference_purity >= 0.70 for every remaining class; PLUS leg R for a partial trigger only: preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1, carried unchanged), abstain (choose returns None). (4) RECENT8 - otherwise act through the acting model exactly. A branch whose trigger fires while the branch is disarmed - by its own arming, by the carried-over authority, by the purity gate, or (abstention only) by leg P or leg R - is recorded (recovery_would_fire / abstention_would_fire / minority_would_fire, plus recovery_disarmed_by_purity / minority_disarmed_by_purity where purity alone blocked a recovery branch, abstention_disarmed_by_purity where leg P blocked abstention, and abstention_disarmed_by_preceding_pair where leg R blocked a partial abstention) and falls through. There is no other input: no stage, phase, rule, or switch information and no fitted probability enters any branch; the acting-window count enters NO branch -- with the widened class removed it is records-only everywhere in this candidate, as it was for the full and partial classes in every graded candidate; the newest-four total is likewise records-only. RELEASE LEG (leg T, THE SINGLE CHANGED ELEMENT of this experiment; see pre_acting_joint_release_leg): each recovery branch above additionally requires its stale-pair count over events[-26:-8] to be < 2 -- the regular branch requires stale_joint_pair_count < 2, the minority branch requires stale_minority_joint_pair_count < 2, each scored with that branch's own joint definition. A branch whose joint test, arming, and leg P all pass but whose stale-pair count is >= 2 does NOT fire; it is recorded as disarmed by staleness and the decision falls through to the next branch in the order above, then to abstention, then to recent8, exactly as a purity-disarmed branch falls through. The abstention branch has NO staleness leg: its classes, gate, and legs are the decisive baseline's, bit for bit. COMPANION LEG (leg C, THE SINGLE CHANGED ELEMENT of this experiment; see companion_concordance_leg): the abstention branch's PARTIAL trigger above additionally fires when leg R fails but leg C passes -- the partial pair's companion event is not reference-concordant -- so the partial gate is leg P AND (leg R OR leg C). The full trigger's gate, both recovery branches (including leg T), the minority branch, the decision order, and every fall-through are the decisive baseline's, bit for bit.
fixed_parameters.decision_rule_rationale: The checkpoint-32 release question is carried as a guard this cycle (its failure recurred on different sub-conditions with leg T's designed population absent), the inverted minority model is demonstrated and carried, the widened class's removal is carried, and the pre-acting grading isolated the one both-cohorts failure that remains on the SAME sub-condition: criterion 9(a), split into complementary halves by the abstention classes' own structure -- a cohort whose taken B1 firings are all full earns no non-full credit, and a cohort whose only taken firings are checkpoint-4 partials can miss the count by one, because the partial class's sole corroboration window (the preceding pair) is pre-switch at checkpoint 2 and retains checkpoint-2 partials at exactly its stationary rate. This cycle therefore varies the one abstention element the published rates indict -- the partial class has no corroboration source INSIDE the newest pair, although the pair itself carries one: its companion event either affirmatively supports the reference rule (concordant) or does not (unmatched) -- and nothing else: both recovery branches incl. leg T, the minority branch and model, leg P, leg R, the trigger classes, and the acting model are the graded pre-acting candidate's, bit for bit, so branch selection is identical except where leg C takes a partial the decisive baseline disarmed, and every outcome difference against the decisive baseline method is attributable to the companion leg. A gate threshold on any recorded quantity was considered at the selection stage and rejected on the recorded evidence: every recorded quantity's interval overlaps across the taken / untaken / stationary populations, so any such threshold would be fitted to inspected per-state counts. Dropping leg R was rejected as the already-graded partial-opposition failure (its stationary cost is priced in the arithmetic scan); reviving the widened class was rejected as undoing the widened-removal grading for a class the published rates show selectivity-negative under both pairs, whose checkpoint-2 B1 population (acting >= 3 with newest4 <= 1) does not cover the disarmed partials in any case (their acting counts are newest-pair-driven, and the class's trigger is a different population). The OR composition is the unique form in the scan that never reduces a baseline rate under either published rate pair while adding corroboration exactly at the checkpoint where the carried leg is structurally scarce.

THIS EXPERIMENT: leg R is carried unchanged (window, scoring, threshold 1) and remains a sufficient corroboration path for partial triggers; the single changed element adds leg C as an ALTERNATIVE path beside it (see companion_concordance_leg). fixed_parameters.reference_purity_gate: CARRIED OVER IDENTICALLY from the graded reference-purity candidate, unchanged and not re-tuned, and applied to the two RECOVERY branches exactly as graded there. Computed from the extended reference window (the 50 events immediately preceding the newest window, indices N-52 .. For each reference event e: let R(e) be the reference expectation for span(e), i.e. the reported outcome class with the strictly highest count among REFERENCE events whose span equals span(e) (tie or empty gives null). e is REFERENCE-MATCHED if R(e) is progress or damage AND e's own reported class is progress or damage; e is REFERENCE-CONCORDANT if reference-matched AND e's reported class EQUALS R(e). reference_matched_count and reference_concordant_count are over the 50 reference events; reference_purity = reference_concordant_count / reference_matched_count (0 if reference_matched_count == 0). (i) THE CHANGED ELEMENT HAS NO NUMERIC VALUE TO TUNE: leg C is binary -- the partial pair's companion event is reference-concordant or it is not -- and the composition (leg P AND (leg R OR leg C) for partial triggers) is selected by a published-rate scan over the four compositions of the two corroboration legs, not fitted: under the matched-adjusted pair (per-event categories: opposite-rule opposed 0.67 / concordant 0.13 / unmatched 0.20; own-rule opposed 0.13 / concordant 0.67 / unmatched 0.20; leg C pass given a partial trigger 0.606 onset vs 0.230 stationary), the OR form's partial take is checkpoint 2 0.310, checkpoint 4 0.423, pooled onset 0.367, stationary 0.094 per state (trigger-level); leg R alone (the decisive baseline) 0.108 / 0.394 / 0.251 / 0.055; leg C alone 0.268 / 0.268 / 0.268 / 0.052; both legs required 0.065 / 0.239 / 0.152 / 0.029; no corroboration leg (the graded partial-opposition composition) 0.442 / 0.442 / 0.442 / 0.226. Under the raw all-matched pair the unmatched share is 0, leg C never arms, and the OR form's rates are exactly the decisive baseline's (pooled onset partial 0.173, stationary 0.081) while the leg-C-alone form's partial class is dead (0 everywhere) -- so the OR form is the only composition that is never worse than the baseline under either pair and strictly adds onset partials under the adjusted pair, concentrated at checkpoint 2 (+0.203 per state) where leg R is structurally scarce, against +0.029 at checkpoint 4 where leg R already retains 0.891 adjusted. The stationary price is +0.039 adjusted per state (~+0.6 firings, ~+9 episodes per cohort; raw +0), keeping the union's stationary trigger expectation at ~25.8 raw / ~26.7 adjusted of 240 episodes, inside criterion 6(a)'s 32 budget in expectation under both pairs. (ii) PRIMARY FLOORS AND MARGINS CARRIED, NOT RE-TUNED: criterion 15 conjoins criterion 9's B1 form (engagement >= 3 of 6 with >= 1 retained-partial non-full firing, B1 harm <= guard AND < recent8), criterion 6's stationary form (abstentions <= 32/240, successes >= recent8 - 6, harm <= recent8), criterion 1's B2 form (engagement >= 3 of 6, selectivity <= 1 of 6 at B1 and at return-A, harm <= guard AND <= 0.60 x recent8, successes >= guard + 16, with the inverted minority model carried), and criterion 5's release form (abstentions <= 36/144, successes >= recent8 - 8, non-recent8 <= 1 of 9, abstained branch 0 of 9), every component carried at its frozen value from the pre-acting protocol, which carried them from its predecessors. (iii) ALL thresholds carried unchanged: leg P at reference_purity >= 0.70 on both recovery branches and as the abstention gate's leg; leg R at preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1; leg T at staleness_pair_threshold 2; joint tests at count >= 1; minority arming at fraction >= 0.25 AND discordant >= 8; abstention triggers at opposed_count == 2 (full) and == 1 (partial); widened threshold recorded records-only as 3, the class removed; companion threshold recorded as null (leg C is binary) -- none re-tuned against any inspected cohort.

First, criterion 9's failure in the pre-acting cycle is isolated to sub-condition (a) on both cohorts, on complementary halves: development TAKEN 3/6 with all three firings full (non-full 0), additional TAKEN 2/6 with both firings retained partials at checkpoint 4; harm passes both comparisons on both cohorts (48 = guard 48 and < recent8 95 development; 60 vs guard 89 and < 89 additional), and no B1 state on either cohort was blocked by leg P (purity armed at all 12 B1 onset states). Second, the untaken B1 population is exactly two configurations: FOUR retained-partial states disarmed by leg R, ALL at checkpoint 2 with preceding_pair_opposed_count 0, and THREE triggerless states at opposed_count 0. The checkpoint-2 concentration is structural, not a fitted pattern: at checkpoint 2 the preceding pair is pre-switch by the segment geometry (only the newest pair is post-switch), so its opposed events accrue at the own-rule rate and leg R's retention there (1-(1-p)^2 = 0.299 raw / 0.243 adjusted) is a distribution IDENTICAL to its stationary retention -- at that geometry leg R thins partials at random and carries no onset information at all, while at checkpoint 4 the preceding pair is post-switch and retention is 0.974 raw / 0.891 adjusted (both taken partials in the pre-acting cycle are checkpoint-4 states). Third, stated honestly, beyond the definitional split (kind is DEFINED by opposed_count) every recorded quantity overlaps between taken-full, taken-partial, untaken, and stationary-taken populations on the inspected draws, so no gate threshold on a recorded quantity has an honest derivation. The remaining honest lever is a quantity no abstention class or gate leg currently reads: the concordance of the partial pair's COMPANION event. A partial pair's non-opposed event is, by construction, either concordant (matched, reported == reference majority: positive evidence FOR the reference rule) or unmatched (reported neutral, or no non-neutral reference majority for its span: no matched evidence either way). On the simulator's published rates alone (full derivation kept with the campaign state; no inspected count used, and the companion quantity was never computed on any inspected state): the matched-adjusted pair decomposes as matched probability m = 0.80 times the raw flip probability (0.80 x 0.1625 = 0.130; 0.80 x 0.8375 = 0.670), with the unmatched share 0.20 rule-independent (neutral outcomes are unchanged by the reversal and flips swap only progress / damage; span-majority availability is a reference-window property). A stationary partial's companion is therefore concordant with probability 0.67/0.87 = 0.77, an onset partial's with probability only 0.13/0.33 = 0.39 -- the companion of a switched segment's event is itself a switched event, whose matched report supports the old rule only at the flip rate. Leg C (companion NOT concordant) passes 0.606 of onset partials against 0.230 of stationary partials under the adjusted pair. The composition scan is a published-rate scan, not a fit: the OR form (leg P AND (leg R OR leg C)) is the unique non-dominated composition -- it never reduces any decisive-baseline rate (under the raw all-matched idealization the unmatched share is 0, leg C is VACUOUS, and every raw rate is exactly the baseline's: pooled onset partial 0.173, stationary partial 0.081), while under the adjusted pair it raises the pooled onset partial take from 0.251 to 0.367 per state (checkpoint 2: 0.108 -> 0.310, where leg R is structurally scarce; checkpoint 4: 0.394 -> 0.423, where leg R already retains), the union's B1 take from 0.700 to 0.816 per state (~4.20 -> ~4.89 of 6 trigger-level; P(taken >= 3/6) 0.929 -> 0.987; P(at least one non-full) 0.823 -> 0.936), at a stationary price of +0.039 per state (~+0.6 firings, ~+9 episodes per cohort), keeping the union's stationary expectation inside criterion 6(a)'s budget under both pairs (~25.8 raw / ~26.7 adjusted of 240 episodes, vs the decisive baseline's ~25.8 / ~17.3). The alternatives are dominated in the same scan: dropping leg R entirely is the graded partial-opposition composition (stationary partial take 0.272 raw / 0.226 adjusted per state, ~65 / ~54 episodes -- criterion 6(a) breached in expectation, and already graded Failed / Regression); replacing leg R with leg C kills the partial class under the raw pair (leg C vacuous there) and lowers the adjusted pooled onset partial take to 0.268; requiring BOTH legs lowers the pooled onset partial take to 0.152 adjusted, below the baseline's 0.251. Leg C has NO free threshold: the companion is concordant or it is not. Two bounds are stated in advance, not discovered afterwards: (i) under raw-like draws leg C never arms, the candidate coincides with the decisive baseline on every state, and the grading cap (an exercised leg-C firing is required for Demonstrated) records the null -- the adjusted expectation is ~0.70 leg-C-exercised B1 states per cohort trigger-level, P(at least one in a cohort) ~0.52; (ii) leg C's checkpoint-32 exposure is priced, not hidden: the leg-C-only pattern (partial trigger, leg R failing, companion unmatched) occurs at 0.029-0.039 per switch-stage checkpoint-32 state adjusted (0 raw) before leg P, the authority, and recovery precedence, so criterion 5(d)'s 0-of-9 abstained-branch form is directly exposed on the additional side of a criterion leg C does not otherwise touch.
